I’m currently pursuing my Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) at C. Abdul Hakeem College (Autonomous), Melvisharam, affiliated with Thiruvalluvar University. I’m in my 6th semester, with an expected graduation in 2027.

I’m a motivated BCA student seeking to apply my knowledge of Python, SQL, Excel, and Power BI alongside web technologies. I’m eager to learn new technologies, sharpen my analytical and technical skills, and contribute effectively to organizational growth.

I like understanding how things work under the hood, then building small, practical projects to prove it to myself — from simple games to billing systems — and I’m constantly working on taking an idea from a rough plan to a working piece of software.
